description:
A widow enters a forbidden marriage with her late husband’s devoted disciple. On their wedding night, grief and desire collide, and she finds herself drawn into a passion she knows she should resist. Haunted by a promise he once made as a boy, and torn between guilt and longing, she must face whether crossing this taboo is true love or an inescapable fate waiting to consume them both.
